<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/team_alert_recipients"}
#docs
One row per address in `team_alerts_config.recipients`. `member`: a team member, gets alerts. `confirmed`: confirmed by email, gets alerts. `pending`: gets no alerts until the address is confirmed.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `team_alert_recipient`. One of `team_alert_recipient`. |
| `data.email` | `string` | The address. |
| `data.state` | `string` | `member`: a team member, gets alerts. `confirmed`: confirmed by email, gets alerts. `pending`: gets no alerts until the address is confirmed. One of `member`, `confirmed`, `pending`. |
| `data.last_sent_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When we last sent the confirmation email. Absent from the resend answer. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such business |
